title: Chapter 11: Attention Across Time And Space
content:
Chapter 11: Attention Across Time And Space

Hu Tu could now clearly see the situation on the battlefield, and he shouted happily: "We are going to win!"

No matter how fervently the bugbears resisted, they could not save the situation.

"Spiritual God is above! Give me strength!"

The voices calling the names of gods rose and fell on the battlefield, but unfortunately their gods did not appear.

The Zerg are a unified whole, and the battlefield cooperation between the puppies and the hydralisk can be said to be seamless and achieve optimal efficiency.

The bugbears kept falling down and turning into light. Hu Tu, who was watching the battle from a distance, saw this.

He asked in surprise: "Brother Wu, why are all the Bugbears and Zerg friends who fell on the battlefield missing?"

"The Zerg have a powerful protector of the clan, who is respected as the Lord by the Zerg. His strength is comparable to that of gods. Those enemies have been sacrificed to the Lord."

"When the Zerg itself dies, it will return to the embrace of the master and wait for rebirth."

Wu Qing deceived without changing his expression.

"I see, it would be great if my clan also had such power!"

Hu Tu didn't have any doubts, but was yearning for it.

At this time, Wu Qing was not as optimistic about the battlefield situation as Hu Tu.

Yesterday evening, he personally felt the mysterious power in the bugbear camp through the puppy. It was that power that protected the bugbears from strange attacks.

This force has not yet appeared, and everything is still subject to change.

On the battlefield, the Zerg's advantage is getting bigger and bigger, and the bugbear knights guarding the priests also join the battle.

"Spiritual God is above! Please give me strength!"

The white-robed priest knelt on the back of the monitor lizard, held an object in his hands, and began to pray devoutly.

A mysterious energy based on faith centered on him and spread to all directions, covering the entire battlefield.

All the surviving bugbears on the battlefield were transformed into giant bodies and entered a terrifying state of rage. They attacked everything around them wildly without distinguishing between friend and foe.

Only the bugbear knight guarding the priest still maintained basic sanity.

All the Zerg on the battlefield felt a pressure mentally, forcing them to surrender and convert.

Unfortunately, the Zerg are naturally immune to all mental attacks, so the sacrifice's operation is ineffective against the Zerg.

Facing the bugbears who were in a state of madness and rage, the puppies relied on their agility to quickly break away from the battle, allowing the transformed bugbears to kill each other.

The puppies' battlefield mission is now complete, and the rest can be left to the Hydralisks.

The puppies were on guard around the battlefield, and the Hydralisks were doing crazy damage outside the field.

The few remaining bugbears kept falling, and soon only the priest and seven or eight bugbear knights were left on the battlefield.

The priest's prayers continued, and an energy field gradually formed around him. This was because spiritual power had interfered with the material reality, and the Hydralisk's attack could not break this energy field for a while.

"No! They have star priests!"

When Hu Tu saw this situation, he immediately shouted.

"Star rating?"

Wu Qing thought about the star-level settings for Zerg buildings and combat units. It turned out that the system was not a star-level setting made out of thin air, but a strength-level setting that already existed in the world.

"Don't worry, he can only be regarded as a false star, using foreign objects."

"Even if it's really a star priest, the Zerg won't be afraid."

Wu Qing said a few words casually.

"I almost forgot that our Zerg friends are different from us. They are a race protected by powerful forces."

Hu Tu's envy at this moment was beyond words.

Seeing Hu Tu's performance, Wu Qing thought to himself: "It seems that people in this world are very insecure. There are some things that can be done."

On the battlefield, the energy field gained from the sacrifices and prayers became more and more powerful, and an unknown existence seemed to be looking here across time and space.

"Don't be so exaggerated! Insect Queen, attack and interrupt him quickly!"

This sudden change caught Wu Qing by surprise and shocked him.

"Since when can a small priest be able to summon gods at will?"

This is indeed very unreasonable.

The Insect Queen used the three hosts near the battlefield as a medium, and a powerful spiritual storm swept across violently. The increasingly stronger energy field in the middle of the battlefield was like a bubble, bursting as soon as it was blown.

The white-robed priest's prayers came to an abrupt end, and his head exploded like a watermelon hit by a bullet.

The bugbear knights and their lizard mounts, including the huge lizard ridden by the priests, all bled to death.

The unknown existence that was about to turn its attention here lost the guidance of this world, immediately lost its target, and slowly disappeared.

"Victory!"

The happy Hu Tu didn't know the secret danger at all, and only saw the victory of the Zerg.

Wu Qing also had a false alarm.

All enemies on the battlefield, no matter who killed them, have a causal relationship with Wu Qing and the Zerg, and the system will automatically clear the battlefield.

The huge battlefield, except for weapons and debris, instantly became clean and bloodless.

"The friends of the Zerg are so powerful! Our native race has a new strength!"

After all, Hu Tu's knowledge was limited and he kept praising the Zerg's strength.

He saw with his own eyes that the Zerg destroyed the Bugbear clan's army, which relieved the imminent crisis in his territory.

"Brother Wu, I'll go back and tell everyone the good news first, so that everyone doesn't take the risk of evacuating!"

Hu Tu couldn't wait to go back.

Wu Qing did not stop him. He thought about it, and with a thought, the biological suit on his body quickly shrank into a small ball.

This scene stunned Hu Tu.

"Hu Tu, this is the Zerg's self-defense weapon. Since you call me big brother, take it as a gift from big brother. Take it for self-defense."

Wu Qing threw the small ball to Hu Tu.

Hu Tu caught it reflexively. Before he could decide whether to accept or refuse, a spike emerged from the small ball in his hand, piercing his skin and extracting his genes.

The Zerg biological suit was thus forcibly bound to the first creature in this world.

Hu Tu was attracted by the information he automatically obtained after binding the biological suit, and was stunned on the spot.

After a while, he came to his senses. According to his wishes, the biological suit multiplied on his body and transformed into a set of gorgeous equipment.

"It's really good! This biological colonization suit is so amazing!"

"But it's too precious, I can't have it!"

Hu Tu likes it, but he really wants to return the biological colonization suit to Wu Qing. He feels that he can't afford such a valuable item.

He doesn't know how to unbind it, and he is so anxious that he scratches his head.

"I'll give it to you, just take it. You helped me a lot today, and you deserve it."

"I'll look for you if I need help in the future."

"You can also come here to find me if you have anything."

After much persuasion, Hu Tu accepted Wu Qing's gift and went back happily to report the news.

In addition to thanking Hu Tu for the information he provided, Wu Qing had many other considerations for giving the biological colonization suit to Hu Tu. It was not a whim decision.
